description.narrative: The Manufacturing Competitiveness Enhancement Programme (henceforth MCEP) is a 700 m. USD programme lasting 6 years and that started in June 2012 to provide enhanced manufacturing support to encourage manufacturers to upgrade their production facilities in a manner that sustains employment and maximises value-addition in the short to medium term. Its stated objective is to improve the competitiveness of manufacturing enterprises and its overall success will hence be assessed in terms of the overall industrial competitiveness performance of South Africa. The project aims at delivering a) an immediate impact review of MCEP, b) the definition of an outcome- and impact oriented monitoring system for MCEP, and c) the plan for a mid-term impact assessment. The underlying definition of impact includes a) impact at the enterprise level (micro), b) impact at the aggregate level (macro), and c) possible unintended impacts.
